name: @aivo/accessibility-contract
description: Canonical, single-source accessibility preference contract shared by the web (apps/web-v2) and mobile (apps/mobile) learner interfaces. Eliminates schema drift: field names, value bounds, AAC input methods, and TTS voices are declared once. The zero-dependency `index` entry is safe for React Native; the `./schema` entry adds Zod validation for the web BFF.
